spans.text: There are a variety of Jewish religious movements, most of which emerged from Rabbinic Judaism, which holds that God revealed his laws and commandments to Moses on Mount Sinai (Bible)Mount Sinai in both the Written Torah () and Oral Torah.
In 2025, the world Jewish population was estimated at 14.8 million, although religious observance varies from strict to non-existent.
